_about: Games from NumPlay (github.com/Mason363/NumPlay, GPL-3.0) listed in Numstore. Only games written for NumPlay with their own art or openly licensed sources. The store downloads each .nwa straight from NumPlay's release; nothing is copied into this repo except the icons, read out of the .nwa files.
author: Mason363 (NumPlay)

games.description: Slide the tiles, merge equal numbers, reach 2048. After Gabriele Cirulli's game.

games.name: Snake
games.description: The classic: eat, grow, don't bite yourself.

games.name: Minesweeper
games.description: Clear the field without stepping on a mine.

games.name: Solitaire
games.description: Klondike patience with the keypad.

games.name: Sudoku
games.description: Number place puzzles, made on the calculator.

games.name: Connect Four
games.description: Line up four discs before the other player.

games.name: Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe
games.description: Tic-tac-toe made of tic-tac-toes: where you play decides where the other plays next.

games.name: NumChess
games.description: Chess on the calculator.

games.name: Mahjong
games.description: Mahjong solitaire: match free tiles to clear KMahjongg's layouts.

games.name: Sokoban
games.description: Push every box onto its spot. David W. Skinner's Microban levels.
games.credit: Levels: Microban by David W. Skinner.

games.name: Block Breaker
games.description: Bounce the ball and break every brick.

games.name: Tower Blocks
games.description: Stack sliding blocks as high as you can. Ported from Steve Gardner's Tower Blocks (MIT).

games.name: Core Ball
games.description: Shoot pins into the spinning core without touching the others. 60 levels, from Random's Core Ball (MIT).
games.credit: Core Ball by Random / Yang Hao (MIT).

games.name: Chrome Dino
games.description: Chrome's offline dinosaur runner, ported from Chromium's source (BSD).

games.name: 2 Players
games.description: Pong, air hockey, maze tanks and light cycles for two on one keypad.

games.name: Imposter
games.description: Party game: pass the calculator, find who doesn't know the secret word.

games.name: Block Blast
games.description: Drop block shapes on the grid and clear full rows and columns. Inspired by Hungry Studio's Block Blast!, written fresh.

games.name: Suika Game
games.description: Drop fruit, merge two of a kind into a bigger one, and don't overflow the jar. Inspired by Aladdin X's Suika Game.
games.credit: Brought to NumPlay by Bobydeluxe. Not affiliated with Aladdin X.

games.name: Flappy Dunk
games.description: Flap a winged basketball through hoop after hoop. Inspired by Voodoo's Flappy Dunk.
games.credit: Brought to NumPlay by Bobydeluxe. Not affiliated with Voodoo.

games.name: Doodle Jump
games.description: Bounce up from platform to platform as high as you can. Inspired by Lima Sky's Doodle Jump, drawn fresh.
games.credit: Brought to NumPlay by Bobydeluxe. Not affiliated with Lima Sky.

games.name: UNO
games.description: The card game by its official rules, against the calculator, with cards drawn for the screen.
games.credit: Brought to NumPlay by Bobydeluxe. Not affiliated with Mattel.

games.name: Famidash
games.description: TFDSoft's NES take on Geometry Dash (MIT), turned into C: 173 levels of jumping to the beat.
games.credit: Famidash by TFDSoft (MIT). Not affiliated with RobTop Games.

games.name: NumDrive
games.description: A Drive Mad style physics driving game: 157 levels of cars, bridges and water.
games.credit: Inspired by Drive Mad; not affiliated with its makers.

games.name: NumPico
games.description: A PICO-8 player for the calculator; add your own carts with NumPlay Studio.
games.credit: femto8 by Ben Baker (MIT), z8lua by Sam Hocevar.

games.name: NumVisuals
games.description: Moving backgrounds (aurora, plasma, warp, code rain…) with a clock, stopwatch, timer, counter or your own words on top.

games.name: Doom
games.description: The 1993 classic on its own engine: the shareware episode Knee-Deep in the Dead, all 9 levels. Big: about 2 MB on the calculator.
games.credit: RP2040 Doom by Graham Sanderson, from Chocolate Doom and id Software's GPL source (GPL-2.0); shareware DOOM1.WAD by id Software. Not affiliated with id Software, ZeniMax or Bethesda.

games.name: NumPowder
games.description: A falling-sand sandbox after The Powder Toy (GPL-3.0): powders, liquids, fire and more.
games.credit: Materials, font and icons from The Powder Toy (GPL-3.0).
